mentions.name: Euforya
mentions.description: A web service that summarizes and simplifies EU laws, resolutions, and decisions. It uses deterministic settings of local LLMs for document summaries so that sharing a prompt can prove the output was not tampered with, and includes a 'broader context' section that adds outputs from several LLMs (from the US, the EU, and China) so users can compare them and guard against disinformation.
mentions.problem: Disinformation: the service designs its AI summaries to be verifiable (deterministic, shareable prompts) and mitigates provider/model bias by comparing outputs from multiple LLMs.
